properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued August 9 at 2:23PM MDT by NWS Pueblo CO
properties.description:
At 222 PM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking gusty showers near Penrose,
or 23 miles south of Colorado Springs, moving east at 10 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 50 mph.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects.

Locations impacted include...
Penrose and Pueblo West.
